prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: final square luxury product photograph for a website comparison slider.
Input image role: exact product and pose identity master, the same original fictional unbranded blue-and-gold watch.
Primary request: create an additional premium presentation-box treatment. Imagine this fictional watch is being revealed as its original exquisite presentation box has just opened. Show the watch nestled naturally on a fitted dark midnight-blue suede cushion inside an open deep navy lacquered watch box with a refined champagne-metal rim, two discreet gold hinges and a plush unbranded lid lining. The hinged lid is raised about 65 degrees and visibly recedes behind the watch at the top of the composition. It should have the tactile luxury and anticipation of an unboxing moment, photographed as a still without people or hands.
Composition: square 1:1 photograph. Preserve the exact watch from the input: same blue sunburst dial, blank unlettered face, fine gold baton indices, slim gold hands at10:10, thin seconds hand, blue hash-mark bezel, polished steel case, understated right crown, wide steel bracelet with the same narrow gold inlay lines. Keep the watch case at the same image coordinates and nearly exact same scale and orientation as the input. Keep all bracelet links and the product silhouette consistent; the fitted cushion is behind and inside its existing bracelet loop. Do not zoom or rotate the watch. This is for a reveal slider, so watch alignment with the input is critical. Make the box surround the existing watch position. A tightly cropped luxury macro composition is welcome: box base and lid may extend partly past image edges, but show enough of the box's inner rim, hinge and raised lid to unmistakably read as a newly opened presentation box. Keep the complete watch visible.
Lighting: cinematic, refined and physically believable, soft warm reveal light falling into the box from upper left, crisp gold/steel reflections, rich navy velvet shadows, gentle cool edge separation, sapphire crystal and dial clear and sharp. Sophisticated advertising product photography with real material detail and restrained contrast.
Constraints: one single watch, one coherent original fictional presentation box, one full-frame photo only. No new watch design, no altered dial or bracelet design, no brand, logo, manufacturer name, lettering, emblems, stamps, watch certificates, papers, watermark, text overlay, extra accessory, people or hands. Preserve unbranded product identity. No split-screen, collage, borders or inset. Box is a fictional design, not packaging copied from any brand.
